components.quote:
Verorab may contain traces of polymyxin B, streptomycin and neomycin, used
    in the manufacturing process (see section 4.3).

components.label: List of excipients (Powder)

Basal Medium Eagle: mixture of mineral salts (including potassium), vitamins,

components.label: List of excipients (Powder)

allergens.quote:
Verorab may contain traces of polymyxin B, streptomycin and neomycin, used
    in the manufacturing process (see section 4.3).

Hypersensitivity to the active substance(s) or to any of the excipients listed in
        section 6.1, to polymyxin B, to streptomycin, to neomycin or to any antibiotic of the
        same class to a previous administration or to any vaccine containing the same
        components.

The tip caps of the prefilled syringes without attached needle contain a natural rubber
latex derivative, which may cause severe allergic reactions in latex sensitive
individuals.

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote:
Hypersensitivity to the active substance(s) or to any of the excipients listed in
        section 6.1, to polymyxin B, to streptomycin, to neomycin or to any antibiotic of the
        same class to a previous administration or to any vaccine containing the same
        components.

warnings.label: Special warning (antibiotic allergy)
warnings.quote:
Use with caution in people with known allergies to polymyxin B, to streptomycin, to
neomycin (present as traces in the vaccine) or to any antibiotic of the same class.

warnings.label: Latex warning
warnings.quote:
The tip caps of the prefilled syringes without attached needle contain a natural rubber
latex derivative, which may cause severe allergic reactions in latex sensitive
individuals.

warnings.label: Latex (packaging description)
warnings.quote:
The tip caps of the prefilled syringes without attached needle contain a natural rubber
latex derivative.

warnings.label: Phenylalanine warning
warnings.quote:
Verorab contains 4.1 micrograms phenylalanine per 0.5 mL-dose which is equivalent
to 0.068 microgram/kg for a 60 kg person. Phenylalanine may be harmful for people
with phenylketonuria (PKU), a rare genetic disorder in which phenylalanine builds up
because the body cannot remove it properly.
